001package org.clafer.javascript;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.FileReader;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStreamReader;
007import java.io.Reader;
008import org.mozilla.javascript.Context;
009import org.mozilla.javascript.ImporterTopLevel;
010import org.mozilla.javascript.Scriptable;
011
012/**
013 * This class provides various methods of loading models, scopes, and objectives
014 * via the Javascript API.
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class Javascript {
019
020    private Javascript() {
021    }
022
023    /**
024     * @return a new Javascript engine.
025     */
026    public static Scriptable newEngine() {
027        Context cxt = Context.enter();
028        cxt.setOptimizationLevel(-1);
029        try {
030            return new ImporterTopLevel(cxt);
031        } finally {
032            Context.exit();
033        }
034    }
035
036    public static JavascriptFile readModel(String in) throws IOException {
037        return readModel("<unknown>", in, newEngine());
038    }
039
040    public static JavascriptFile readModel(File in) throws IOException {
041        return readModel(in, newEngine());
042    }
043
044    public static JavascriptFile readModel(Reader in) throws IOException {
045        return readModel("<unknown>", in, newEngine());
046    }
047
048    public static JavascriptFile readModel(File in, Scriptable engine) throws IOException {
049        return readModel(in.getName(), in, engine);
050    }
051
052    public static JavascriptFile readModel(String name, String in, Scriptable engine) throws IOException {
053        JavascriptContext context = new JavascriptContext();
054        Context cxt = Context.enter();
055        cxt.setOptimizationLevel(-1);
056        try {
057            engine.put("rc", engine, context);
058            cxt.evaluateReader(engine,
059                    new InputStreamReader(Javascript.class.getResourceAsStream("header.js")),
060                    "header.js", 1, null);
061            cxt.evaluateString(engine, in, name, 1, null);
062            return new JavascriptFile(
063                    context.getModel(),
064                    context.getScope(engine),
065                    context.getClaferOption(),
066                    context.getObjectives(),
067                    context.getAssertions(),
068                    context.hasIntRange());
069        } finally {
070            Context.exit();
071        }
072    }
073
074    public static JavascriptFile readModel(String name, File in, Scriptable engine) throws IOException {
075        return readModel(name, new FileReader(in), engine);
076    }
077
078    public static JavascriptFile readModel(String name, Reader in, Scriptable engine) throws IOException {
079        JavascriptContext context = new JavascriptContext();
080        Context cxt = Context.enter();
081        cxt.setOptimizationLevel(-1);
082        try {
083            engine.put("rc", engine, context);
084            cxt.evaluateReader(engine,
085                    new InputStreamReader(Javascript.class.getResourceAsStream("header.js")),
086                    "header.js", 1, null);
087            cxt.evaluateReader(engine, in, name, 1, null);
088            return new JavascriptFile(
089                    context.getModel(),
090                    context.getScope(engine),
091                    context.getClaferOption(),
092                    context.getObjectives(),
093                    context.getAssertions(),
094                    context.hasIntRange());
095        } finally {
096            Context.exit();
097        }
098    }
099}
